goal: Allow disabling periodic wallet transaction rebroadcasts without turning off initial broadcasts
Prevent privacy leaks where periodic announcements to peers reveal transaction ownership
agreement: Unaddressed objection: defaulting rebroadcast to false harms user convenience (vicjuma)
Questioned whether disabling rebroadcast is safe or needed at all (w0xlt)
Suggested extending -walletbroadcast modes instead of adding another option (w0xlt)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a significant privacy leak that links transaction ownership to the node's wallet
Users previously had no way to stop periodic rebroadcasts without disabling initial broadcasts entirely
